company.shortDescription: Xare is a revolutionary way for you to share access to your credit or debit cards with anyone, anywhere –securely, instantly
company.description: Xare is a fintech company that provides digital payment and money transfer services. The platform allows users to share access to their credit or debit cards securely and send money to family or friends across countries. Xare mainly focuses on helping people manage and share financial resources more easily through its app.
